ab_a_short_pantry.accept_text:
A desert doesn't offer much to eat, and I've learned what it does offer over four camps. Most of our meat is Pitfall Kodo. Pit Shrike's good too, if you don't mind the plucking.

You'll find both around Cartfall, west of here. The camp's larder is nearly empty, so kill some of each and I'll butcher them. I'll cook you a plate for it.

ab_drovers_in_the_sand.accept_text:
I cooked for caravans for eleven years before this, and I'll tell you the thing about drovers. They don't stop. Weather, raiders, a broken axle, the road keeps going and so do they.

The ones out there still haven't stopped. Bring me their tags. I want to cook for a camp that's done right by them, and we haven't.

They're still on the old road at Cartfall, west of camp, and at the First Hole beyond it.

ab_everything_points_east.accept_text:
Sepp has brine. Hask has four shrike crops with water animals in them. Vizzi has a hundred and twenty feet of line that doesn't reach anything, twice. And there's light coming up out of the ground.

I'm a surveyor, so I don't get to say what that means. I do get to say that every single one of those points the same direction, and I want one more set of readings before I write the sentence.

Underlight is south of camp, down the east side, so start there. Bring me wet scale off the deepwater horrors, and put down the saltbone revenants on the way. They walk the ground between here and there.

ab_feeding_from_below.accept_text:
Go through the bestiary of this place with me. Crawlers are cave animals. Oozes are cave animals. The horrors in the Throats are aquatic. The revenants are brine.

There isn't one thing on this map that belongs in a desert except the shrikes, and the shrikes are here because everything else is here.

The entire population of this zone is a consequence of the water leaving. Bring me enough residue to say that with a number on it.

The Glasswall, south of camp, has the most of them in one place.

ab_is_it_possible.accept_text:
I've got two years of pairs, and I'm close to being able to say a sentence I can defend. I'd like one more set from the south, where the revenants are, and then I'm going to say it whether the port likes it or not.

What I need is the settled residue the hollowing oozes leave behind. Take it off the oozes themselves.

ab_lit_from_below.accept_text:
It isn't fire, because fire flickers and that doesn't. It isn't the glass either. It's the wrong colour and in the wrong place.

What it does do is get slightly brighter every season, which I've measured, and I'd like a sample of everything living within forty feet of it before I say anything about that in front of Peska.

Underlight is south of camp, down the east side, past the Glasswall. I need the glasswall elementals, the hollowing oozes, and a still-wet scale off each deepwater horror you can reach.

ab_managed_not_solved.accept_text:
Peska wants the readings. Hask wants his method. Vizzi wants a floor under every rope.

I want the camp to still be here in a month, and that's a different list, and it's mostly killing.

I'm not going to dress it up. Go and make the ground round this peg quiet for a while.

That means the sinkhole lurkers and the limestone crawlers. Kill both, and bring me the lurkers' spurs so I can show Peska the count.

ab_nine_have_floors.accept_text:
Somebody has to go down them. It isn't far, just far enough to see whether there's a floor and whether the floor is going anywhere.

Nine of the eleven have floors, and two don't. I'd like a second pair of hands on the line, and I'd like them attached to somebody who can fight, because the floors aren't empty.

What's on those floors is limestone crawlers. Clear them before the line goes down.

ab_nothing_is_hot_enough.turn_in_text:
Here's the entry: cause unknown, sixty feet, south-facing, post-collapse, samples taken, no local heat source identified.

That's it in the book. I feel worse than I expected and better than I deserve.

ab_peg_irons.turn_in_text:
These will do nicely. I tried it with a scrap of shell last month and the crawlers left that peg alone, so now I can line the whole batch.

The survey's stakes are going to be armoured with the animal that eats them. I'd like Peska to write that in her book.

ab_reading_the_pan.turn_in_text:
You got a good handful off a stretch I called thin, and Peska's rod came back at eleven on the stretch either side of it.

I won't call that proof yet. It's the first thing I've had that's even the same shape as proof.

ab_the_long_collapse.accept_text:
The Long Collapse opened eleven months ago, over a single afternoon, and it took twenty-two tiles of ground and a stretch of the old road with it.

It's the only one any of us watched happen. I want the rim walked, and I want it walked by somebody who isn't me, because I've walked it nine times and I've stopped seeing it.

The Long Collapse is south-west of camp, on past the Wide Sink. Sinkhole lurkers den under the rim. Kill the ones you meet and bring me their spurs, because Peska says the spur tells her how deep they came up from.

ab_the_south_facing.accept_text:
Twice a year the sun hits the Glasswall at the right angle and it throws the light back at the camp. For forty minutes we're the brightest place in Tanaris. Tobbit says it's a hazard and Hask says it's beautiful.

I like to stand on the rise and watch it, and lately Glasswall Elementals have been coming up the slope at me from the pit, south of here. Get rid of them for me. Then ask me about the glass, and you'll hear what the rest of the camp thinks.
ab_the_south_facing.turn_in_text:
That's much better. Now I can watch it without keeping one eye on the slope.

It's the only thing out here that keeps a schedule, and I look forward to it.

ab_the_throats.accept_text:
The Throats are the two with no floor, and they're the two I won't go down past forty feet.

There's something living in them that's wet. I need scale off whatever you can reach, and somebody else has to be holding the knife, because I've been down that hole nine times and the tenth is where people stop coming back.

The Throats are in the far south-west, the whole desert away from this camp. The wet things are deepwater horrors. Kill them at the rim and cut the scale off them while it's still wet.

ab_the_two_without.accept_text:
Nine have floors and two don't. Underlight is south of here, down the east side. The Throats are in the far south-west.

I've been down both to the end of my line, and the line is a hundred and twenty feet, and it doesn't reach anything.

Walk both rims for me in one day, in order, and tell me whether you come back thinking what I think.

Deepwater horrors climb out of both. Kill what you meet on each rim.

ab_three_month_contract.accept_text:
I came out with the second camp on a three-month contract.

That was two years and two camps ago, and nobody has ever mentioned the contract again, including me.

I'm not complaining, and I'd like that understood before I ask you for anything. Go south and make the run to the Throats survivable for a woman carrying glass, and I'll tell you why I stayed.

The saltbone revenants and the sinkhole lurkers are what make that run dangerous. Kill them along it.

dd_teeth_of_the_old_sea.turn_in_text:
Every one of them is sharper than my best edge. You couldn't buy these anywhere.

The first file goes on the Fourth Peg forge. This one's for you. I made it the old way, because the new file isn't cut yet.

dd_up_a_different_hole.turn_in_text:
All three, and you never came up once.

Then I know where my team ended up, and I can get down there myself to see to them. I've wanted to for a long time.

dd_where_the_brine_comes_from.accept_text:
I told Peska the revenants had been cured in brine and that the nearest brine was four days away. I was wrong about the second part.

Vizzi's lamp went down the First Hole last week and came back up crusted white. There's salt under the First Hole, in layers, where the old sea dried out a bit at a time. Vizzi calls it the Salt Galleries. It's past the bottom of the First Hole, to the north-west, as far as the cave goes.

Something down in the salt is curing them. Vizzi saw a revenant twice the size of the others, standing in the salt like it was waiting. The crew call it the Salt Widow. Kill it, and bring me a lump of the salt it stands in.
